training: Start both from complete V1global51. Add two zero-output64->256 bias-free projections each arm,32768parameters. Mixed control usesGELU((u+v)/sqrt2),GELU((u-v)/sqrt2); separate candidate usesGELU(u),GELU(v). Keep original direct path, cross product and gate. All TabM trains20epochs, original parameters3e-5,new projections3e-4. Original CE+0.1count, same original row budgets, online AWGN/dropout/order and Val rules as S0. No P1/restoration loss or architecture changes elsewhere.
selection: Same V1 protection and mean5/0ACC,mean5/0Single,rawACC score, actual epochs1..20. Each candidate selected independently on Val. Rank finalists before Test, evaluate only task-passing candidates. Never choose the winning architecture from Test.
source_idea: Adapt main-effect/interaction separation within the first TabM layer, inspired by GAMI-Net(2021), not a reproduction of its complete model or identifiability constraints. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.patcog.2021.108192
